label: Extreme Cold
summary: Extreme cold is weather cold enough to harm your body. Snow and ice can also make travel and everyday tasks harder.

items.label: Stay in a heated place
items.body: Outside, wear warm layers, cover your head and hands, and change out of wet clothes.

items.label: Use safe heating
items.body: Never use a stove, oven, or indoor generator for warmth. Keep heaters away from anything that can burn.

items.label: Check on neighbors
items.body: Report unresolved heat problems and plan where to go if your home becomes too cold.

Stay safe in winter weather
items.body: Safe heating, cold weather, snow, and utility interruptions.

items.label: Report missing heat or hot water
items.body: Contact your landlord first, then report unresolved problems. NYCHA residents should use NYCHA repair channels.

items.label: Request help for someone living outside
items.body: Homeless outreach and Code Blue information. Call 911 for immediate medical danger.

items.label: Recognize cold-related health risks
items.body: Cold weather safety and ways to support people at greater risk. Translated cold weather materials.

items.label: Check help paying for heat
items.body: Heating and emergency assistance for eligible households. Check application periods and funding availability. Translated program information.

items.label: Ask about emergency financial assistance
items.body: Possible help with an emergency, rent, or utility bills. Eligibility applies; some assistance requires repayment.

items.label: Request repairs in NYCHA housing
items.body: Heat, hot water, and other repairs. Call 718-707-7771.

items.label: Prevent carbon monoxide poisoning
items.body: Alarm and fuel-burning appliance safety. If an alarm sounds or poisoning is suspected, leave and call 911.

items.label: Find snow and severe weather updates
items.body: City notices and service updates. Use Notify NYC for alerts.

items.label: Find support for an older adult
items.body: Meals, case management, caregiver help, and local centers. Call Aging Connect at 212-244-6469. Phone language assistance available.

items.label: Queens Community House older adult support
items.body: Local centers, case management, and home-delivered meals for eligible older adults. Confirm service area and enrollment.

items.label: Ask Con Edison about bill assistance
items.body: Discounts and payment assistance for eligible customers in most of Queens.

items.label: Ask PSEG Long Island about bill assistance
items.body: Payment and financial assistance for eligible customers in the Rockaways.
